subject: NULL object reference
notes: "Predefined object reference NULL contains the null object reference value; this is a unique value defined by the implementor such that it is guaranteed to never reference an object." (cite.py --check 8.4.3.7.4 -> OK). In the typed-native model NULL is the .NET null reference, which by construction references no object. Probed at 2002 and 2023 (p4.cob): a NEW instance compares NOT = NULL. After `SET G H TO NULL`, G = NULL and H = NULL (both operand orders, NULL = G). A universal reference set TO NULL equals NULL and equals a typed reference holding NULL, so there is one unique null value across categories. INVOKE on a null reference raises EC-OO-NULL (conformance:cases/14.9.23-INVOKE/ec_oo_null_invoke, §14.9.23.4 GR5). conformance:cases/8.4.3.7-NULL-object-reference/oo_universal_relation derives its expected values from this GR: the initial U = NULL, and after NEW U NOT = NULL.
